title: Steps to request Supplementary Credit Card

steps.text: Log in to the mobile application and land on the cards dashboard page.
Select Credit Card. Then Click on “Apply Supplementary Card”

Select Card Limit 
Select relationship to supplementary cardholder “Parents 
Siblings” / “Spouse or Children” 
Select supplementary cardholder name from dropdown list 
Enter supplementary cardholder mobile number 
Click Next
